text:
Maya: Heads-up — spotted a 65% drop in API calls from NebulaRetail this week, started Wed. Usage graph: https://redwood.app/nb/nebula/usage :eyes:
Jordan: Who's the champion there now?
Maya: Their ML lead, @Carlos, left last month. Contract renewal in 45 days. Procurement reached out for pricing but also mentioned Vendor X pilot running.
Priya: Oof. Do we have recent NPS/feedback? Any open tickets?
Maya: NPS 8 two months ago, but last 30d support tickets spiked (embedding latency). Ticket #5542 shows KV-cache misconfig on their end. I pinged eng but no fix shipped.
Sam: I can triage KV-cache config — can you DM me sample request IDs?
Maya: Sent sample IDs in DM. Also they asked for a dedicated throughput guarantee in the pilot.
Priya: Sounds like procurement is being nudged by price+SLA. We should run a re-engagement: 1) quick health call w/ Carlos' replacement 2) offer a targeted perf run 3) present cost vs Vendor X — can we get telemetry into a one-pager?
Maya: I'll own the health call. Sam can run perf run. @Priya can you draft the one-pager? Use last quarter cost delta and token-level breakdown.
Priya: On it. ETA EOD tomorrow. Will include chart + recommended dedicated burst config.
Sam: Perf run scheduled Thu 10am PT. Need sample corpus and target latency SLOs.
Maya: I'll loop in their new ML lead, Lina, and Ops. Lina's email lina@nebularetail.com
Priya: Also propose a short exec QBR — procurement likes that.
Jordan: Do we want to pre-offer a 3-week trial of Dedicated with a small discount to avoid churn?
Maya: Let's hold discount until the perf run confirms uplift. If perf run looks good, sign off on trial + SLA.
Sam: I'll include KV-cache and batch config in the test. Also will snapshot logs and share playbook commands:
```
redwood perf-run --account nebula --dataset sample-1 --target-latency 120ms --kv-cache on
```
Maya: Next steps: Maya schedule call with Lina (today/tomorrow), Sam run perf run Thu, Priya one-pager EOD tomorrow. I'll update thread after call. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Added to my calendar. Sharing draft in #customer-success-docs after finished.
Jordan: If we need legal amendment for trial terms, ping me and I'll fast-track.
Maya: Thanks team — will update after 1pm PT call.
Bot (calendar): Event created — "NebulaRetail health + perf" Thu 10:00 PT. Attendees: Maya, Sam, Lina, Priya
Maya: Call complete — Lina is receptive, small infra gap, wants to see perf numbers. Sam's run showed 30% p90 improvement w/ KV-cache. Priya's one-pager looks solid. Procurement asked for 14-day dedicated trial. Recommend ok to offer with trial terms.
Priya: Drafted trial terms, uploading to drive: https://drive.redwood/trials/nebula/trial-terms.pdf
Jordan: Great — schedule trial start and track usage weekly. Set renewal playbook in CRM.
Maya: Marking this as 'salvageable' — moving to owned. Closing thread and will file recap in Gainsight.
